description: Repo-controlled repair/validation data for pioarduino's tool-scons (no network). Each supported SCons version records the sha256 of the two modules the firmware link needs (SCons.Tool.FortranCommon <- SCons.Tool.linkCommon.smart_link, which imports SCons.Scanner.Fortran). 4.11.1 is 'repairable': the vendored payload under payload/ is installed when the active engine is missing/corrupt (pioarduino's C3 custom-core rebuild leaves it incomplete). 4.8.1 is validate-only: pioarduino ships it complete, so a mismatch is a hard failure, not something we overwrite. An active SCons version absent from this map is a hard failure.
